scope: Fresh matched local screen of four fixed output decoders on identical frozen C749 parameters.
order: Listed map order, listed identical engine/policy seeds, then exact frozen roster order. One attempt per identity.
withheld_confirmation_policy: Two fresh families and two pair seeds each. Only an approved qualified nominee and T1-control may run in a new authorized phase. Confirm no regression in exit/survival/key/unlock per family and meaningful gain on both families.

promotion_gate.legal: Eight completed legal episodes per model, paired with T1-control; zero invalid actions or timeouts.
promotion_gate.preserve: Match or exceed T1-control exits, survivals, collected keys and verified unlocks on every family. No net loss of measured player damage.
promotion_gate.material_outcome: On two independent families improve exits, keys, unlocks, player-attributed damage, or coverage with a lower blocked-move fraction. At least one gain family must show a gain on both predeclared seeds. Fewer attacks or lower bias alone are diagnostic.
promotion_gate.decision: If the gate fails, retain T1-control. A qualifying variant also requires untouched confirmation, exact official validator and explicit approval for any replacement.
